options.description: Whether the service serves the bulk EHR delete of the Admin API or has it disabled and answers 405.

Whether the service processes an EHR delete of the Admin API synchronously, answering 204 once the EHR is physically deleted, or asynchronously, answering 202 once the delete is accepted. The Admin API is in the DEVELOPMENT state in Release-1.1.0; a service that does not serve it selects neither arm.

Whether the service refuses a SUM or AVG over an input type outside the function's declared types, or executes it. AQL names the types and assigns no outcome to another, so both arms are open until upstream report #229 is settled, and neither arm has a document yet.

Whether the service resolves a TERMINOLOGY() call against an external terminology server. Which servers a service reaches is its own configuration, so a service that reaches none declares the other arm, which has no document.

Whether the service refuses a query whose CONTAINS names a pair of classes the RM defines no containment for, or executes it to an empty result. AQL assigns neither, so both arms are open until upstream report #161 is settled, and neither arm has a document yet.
Whether the service requires authentication. The release recommends an HTTP authentication framework and mandates no scheme, so a service that requires none has no refusal to test.

Whether the service serves a COMPOSITION in the Simplified Flat JSON format when a client asks for it with Accept. The release recommends the Simplified Formats, so a service that does not serve this one answers 406.

Whether the service processes a COMPOSITION sent in the Simplified Flat JSON format on the COMPOSITION create and update. The release recommends the Simplified Formats, so a service that does not process this one answers 415.

Whether the service serves a COMPOSITION in the Simplified Structured JSON format when a client asks for it with Accept. The release recommends the Simplified Formats, so a service that does not serve this one answers 406.

Whether the service processes a COMPOSITION sent in the Simplified Structured JSON format on the COMPOSITION create and update. The release recommends the Simplified Formats, so a service that does not process this one answers 415.

Whether the service serves the COMPOSITION resource family (the COMPOSITION, its VERSIONED_COMPOSITION, their versions and the revision history) in canonical XML when a client asks for it with Accept application/xml.
Whether the service processes a COMPOSITION sent as canonical XML on the COMPOSITION create and update, an instance of the composition element the published ITS-XML schema declares.

Whether the service refuses a committed member of a container attribute that matches none of the attribute's object constraints. The released AM states the alternative-matching rule for single-valued attributes only, so both postures stay open until upstream report #307 is settled.

Whether the service serves a CONTRIBUTION when a client asks for it with Accept application/openehr.wt.flat+json, on a read and in the answer of a create. The release recommends the Simplified Formats, so a service that does not serve this one answers 406.

Whether the service processes a CONTRIBUTION sent with Content-Type application/openehr.wt.flat+json, whose canonical envelope carries its members' data in the Simplified Flat JSON format. The release recommends the Simplified Formats, so a service that does not process this one answers 415.

Whether the service serves a CONTRIBUTION when a client asks for it with Accept application/openehr.wt.structured+json, on a read and in the answer of a create. The release recommends the Simplified Formats, so a service that does not serve this one answers 406.

Whether the service processes a CONTRIBUTION sent with Content-Type application/openehr.wt.structured+json, whose canonical envelope carries its members' data in the Simplified Structured JSON format. The release recommends the Simplified Formats, so a service that does not process this one answers 415.
Whether the service serves a CONTRIBUTION in canonical XML when a client asks for it with Accept application/xml, on a read and in the answer of a create.

Whether the service processes a CONTRIBUTION sent as canonical XML on the CONTRIBUTION create. No published XSD declares an element or a type for the commit envelope (upstream report #759), so the accepting arm has no document yet.
Whether the service serves a CONTRIBUTION of the Demographic API in canonical XML when a client asks for it with Accept application/xml, on the read and as the answer of the commit.

Whether the service processes a CONTRIBUTION sent as canonical XML on the commit of the Demographic API. No published XSD declares a document element or a type for the commit envelope (upstream report #759), so the accepting arm has no document yet.

Whether the service serves the directory FOLDER in canonical XML when a client asks for it with Accept application/xml: on a read, latest and by version_uid, and in the answer of a create and of an update.

Whether the service processes a directory FOLDER sent as canonical XML on the directory create and update. The global `items` element (LOCATABLE) of documents/Structure.xsd gives a FOLDER a conforming root, but no released sentence requires a service to accept that root (upstream report #759), so the accepting arm's workflows rest on that report.

Whether the service serves an EHR_STATUS, on a read and as the representation of an update, when a client asks for it with Accept application/openehr.wt.flat+json. The release defines no EHR_STATUS form in the Simplified Flat JSON format (upstream report #352), so the serving arm has no document.

Whether the service processes an EHR_STATUS sent with Content-Type application/openehr.wt.flat+json on the EHR creates and the EHR_STATUS update. The release defines no EHR_STATUS form in the Simplified Flat JSON format (upstream report #352), so the accepting arm has no document.

Whether the service serves an EHR_STATUS, on a read and as the representation of an update, when a client asks for it with Accept application/openehr.wt.structured+json. The release defines no EHR_STATUS form in the Simplified Structured JSON format (upstream report #352), so the serving arm has no document.

Whether the service processes an EHR_STATUS sent with Content-Type application/openehr.wt.structured+json on the EHR creates and the EHR_STATUS update. The release defines no EHR_STATUS form in the Simplified Structured JSON format (upstream report #352), so the accepting arm has no document.

Whether the service serves the EHR_STATUS resource family (the EHR_STATUS, its VERSIONED_EHR_STATUS, their versions and the revision history) in canonical XML when a client asks for it with Accept application/xml.

Whether the service processes an EHR_STATUS sent as canonical XML on the EHR_STATUS update. No published document schema reaches EHR_STATUS: the global `items` element (LOCATABLE) of documents/Structure.xsd does not include Ehr.xsd, which only the 2.0.0 lineage publishes, and no released sentence names the root a service accepts (upstream report #759). The accepting arm sends an `items` root typed EHR_STATUS in that lineage's namespace, so its workflow rests on that report.
Whether the service serves the EHR resource in canonical XML, on a read and as the representation of a create, when a client asks for it with Accept application/xml.

Whether the service processes an EHR_STATUS sent as canonical XML on the EHR creates. No published document schema reaches EHR_STATUS: the global `items` element (LOCATABLE) of documents/Structure.xsd does not include Ehr.xsd, which only the 2.0.0 lineage publishes, and no released sentence names the root a service accepts (upstream report #759). The accepting arm sends an `items` root typed EHR_STATUS in that lineage's namespace, so its workflows rest on that report.

Whether the service serves each of the five PARTY kinds of the Demographic API (PERSON, AGENT, GROUP, ORGANISATION and ROLE) in canonical XML when a client asks for it with Accept application/xml, on a read and as the answer of a create or update.

Whether the service processes a PARTY sent as canonical XML on the create and update of each PARTY kind. The one published global element of a type a PARTY extends is `items` (LOCATABLE) in documents/Structure.xsd, and that schema does not include Demographic.xsd, where the PARTY types are defined, so no published document schema reaches the PARTY types (upstream report #759). The accepting arm sends an `items` root typed with each PARTY kind in the 2.0.0 lineage's namespace, so its workflows rest on that report.

Whether the service restricts a query to the EHR the ehr_id query parameter or the openehr-ehr-id request header names. The release lets the backend use the scope for routing and optimisation, so a service that treats it as a hint declares the other arm, which has no document.

Whether the service still serves a template example when a client asks for it with the deprecated media types application/openehr.wt.flat.schema+json and application/openehr.wt.structured.schema+json. A service that has dropped them answers 406.

Whether the service still processes a COMPOSITION sent with the deprecated media types application/openehr.wt.flat.schema+json and application/openehr.wt.structured.schema+json. The release deprecates them in favour of their current equivalents, so a service may have dropped them and then answers 415.

Whether the service serves a template example when a client asks for it with the legacy ECISFLAT media type application/openehr.nc.flat+json. The release names the format and does not define it, so the serving arm has no document; a service that does not serve it answers 406.

Whether the service processes a COMPOSITION sent with the legacy ECISFLAT media type application/openehr.nc.flat+json. The release names the format and does not define it, so the accepting arm has no document; a service that does not process it answers 415.

Whether the service serves the example data instance of a stored ADL 1.4 or ADL 2 operational template in the Simplified Flat JSON format when a client asks for it with Accept. The release recommends the Simplified Formats, so a service that does not serve this one answers 406.

Whether the service serves the example data instance of a stored ADL 1.4 or ADL 2 operational template in the Simplified Structured JSON format when a client asks for it with Accept. The release recommends the Simplified Formats, so a service that does not serve this one answers 406.
Whether the service serves the example data instance of a stored ADL 1.4 or ADL 2 operational template in canonical XML when a client asks for it with Accept application/xml.

Whether the service serves an ADL 1.4 operational template in the Web Template format when a client asks for it with Accept, on the template read and as the representation of an upload. The release recommends the Simplified Formats, so a service that does not serve this one answers 406.

What the service does with a committed coded value whose archetype constraint binding it cannot resolve, because the terminology query server is unreachable or does not know the value set: refuse the commit, or accept it. Which terminology servers a service reaches is its own configuration. The accepted arm carries the accepted twin of the DV_CODED_TEXT external-term refusals; the refused arm has no document, since a refusal of a complete term proves no acceptance.

Whether the service makes a digital signature of each VERSION at committal and stores it in ORIGINAL_VERSION.signature. RM common makes the signature optional and leaves its serialisation to be determined, so the signing arm judges the presence of the signature only, and a service that signs nothing has no document.

Whether the service serves the VERSIONED_PARTY family of the Demographic API (the VERSIONED_PARTY, its versions and its revision history) in canonical XML when a client asks for it with Accept application/xml.

Which published canonical XML lineage the service serves: the Release-1.0.2 schemas in namespace http://schemas.openehr.org/v1, or the Release-2.0.0 schemas in http://schemas.openehr.org/v2. The release requires conformance to "the published XSDs" and names neither, so neither arm has a document yet.

reports.title: AQL never assigns a behaviour to a containment pair the RM defines no relationship for
AQL leaves SUM and AVG over an input type outside their declared set unassigned
AM never states whether a data node matching no constraint node is invalid
ITS-REST declares the Simplified Formats for EHR_STATUS, FOLDER and the PARTY kinds, which the Simplified Formats specification never maps
LOCATABLE.archetype_node_id's description says "Always in the form of an at-code" and contradicts itself two sentences later
RM: REVISION_HISTORY.items is most-recent-first in the class purpose and most-recent-last everywhere else
ITS-REST: return=identifier is a SHOULD in one section and "never 204" with no keyword in another
Simplified Formats: the RM mapping tables name RM attributes and types the RM does not have
ITS-JSON: DV_URI and DV_EHR_URI require no value, and DV_INTERVAL limits are untyped objects
ITS-REST: the bulk EHR delete declares its ehr_id subset as one UUID and templates it into the path
ITS-REST: the ITEM_TAG operations leave invariant refusals, filter matching and tag identity unassigned
ITS-REST: deleted-version reads, deactivated-EHR writes and the update body uid have no assigned answer, and the RM and ITS-REST disagree on the copied uid
SMART on openEHR: the discovery example and scope grammar contradict each other, and no scope maps to an operation
ITS-REST: the Simplified Formats and canonical XML chapters require what they leave undefined
AQL: AND and OR precedence, regex node predicates, LIKE escapes, basic-format dates, whole-value comparisons and supertype paths are unassigned
AM: OPT2 says an operational template has no specialisation statement, while AOM2 and the ADL2 example require one
AM: the ADL2 operational template example binds its category at-code without the operational binding namespace
AM: ADL2 examples constrain the DV_QUANTITY property the RM removed, with external codes AOM2 cannot hold
BASE: ARCHETYPE_ID admits only a major version, while AM Identification and ADL 2 require the three-part version
